comments:
According to a post-colophon verse, it took about 40 days to put the text into writing.
A post-colophon addition provides a lineage, in which the last legible name is 'Bre shes rab 'bar (ID:3807), followed by some more names.

item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
Number on the last folio: 161.
Fol. 1 missing.
The numbers 143 and 144 appear on the same folio page. 
Orthography:
- Some abbreviations (e.g., ye shes)
- Bindu for m
Numerous annotations between the lines and in the margins, some in larger characters probably by another hand (e.g., 14b, 17a).
